settings.colorHint: Used in the monogram and badges.
settings.leaveHint: You lose access to the team's workspaces. Coming back takes a new invitation.
settings.leaveText: You lose access to the team's workspaces. Coming back takes a new invitation.
settings.transferHint: Another member becomes Captain; you become Admin.
settings.transferText: The member you choose becomes Captain. You stay in the team as Admin.
settings.deleteHint: Irreversible. The team's workspaces are deleted with it.
settings.deleteText: The team and all its workspaces are deleted for good. Type {{team}} to confirm.
settings.slugHint: Set when the team was created; it does not change.
settings.membersCreateHint: Otherwise only the Admins and the Captain can. Viewers never can.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.seeDetail: See what each role can do

short.captain: Every right, deleting the team included.
short.member: Works in the workspaces and invites guests.

long.captain: Every right on the team and its workspaces, including deleting them. There is one Captain; the role moves only by transfer.
long.admin: Edits the team, invites and manages members below their own role, creates and configures the team's workspaces.
long.member: Works in the team's workspaces and can invite guests into them.

roles.footnote: The Captain is unique and cannot be restricted.

rows.changeRoles: Change the role of a lower member
rows.createWorkspace: Create a workspace for the team
rows.inviteGuest: Invite a guest into a workspace

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.text: The invitation waits among their pending invitations until they accept or decline it.
invite.hintInvitation: Valid for 7 days. One person per invitation.

link.title: Invitation link
link.text: To share outside PwnForge (Discord, email). Anyone signed in who opens it can join the team while it is valid.
link.dialogText: Whoever opens it joins {{team}} with this role.
link.maxUsesHint: Left empty, the link works as many times as needed until it expires.
link.doneText: Share it with the people who should join {{team}}.
link.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the link and copy it by hand.
link.once: This link will never be shown again. Copy it now: to get another one, revoke this link and create a new one.

table.title: Pending invitations
table.revokeLinkText: The link stops working at once. People who already joined through it stay members.
table.revokePersonText: {{name}} will no longer be able to accept it. You can invite them again.
table.empty: No pending invitation. Invite someone by name or address, or create a link.
table.emptyMine: You have no pending invitation. The team's others are under All.
table.footnote: A link's address is not shown after it is created. To get a new one, revoke the link and create another.

validation.whoRequired: Enter a username or an address.
